summary: Pembina Pipeline filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) furnishing a news release dated October 5, 2026, declaring quarterly cash dividends on eight series of preferred shares (Series 1, 3, 5, 7, 15, 17, 21 and 25), with per-share amounts ranging from C$0.372063 to C$0.425875. Record dates run November 2 or December 15, 2026, with payment dates from November 16 to December 31, 2026. The release also schedules Q3 2026 results for November 5 and a November 6 conference call. No special-situation or deal terms are present.
